# Hanzo Skills

> 1472 skills and HIP specifications across 14 categories for building, customizing, and modding Hanzo apps, backends, agents, MCP servers, and cloud infrastructure.
> Open-source, local-first, native compiled code (Go, Rust, C++). Plain markdown over HTTPS, zero auth.

## Progressive Discovery (3 Tiers — Do Not Load Everything Up Front)

1. **Tier 0 (this file)**: Pick a category below or read `GET https://hanzoskills.com/catalog.json`.
2. **Tier 1 (category / ranking)**: Fetch ONLY the matching category `GET https://hanzoskills.com/categories/<slug>.md` (or `.json`), invoke `/skill`, or call `POST https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/tool/detect` to rank skills for a prompt.
3. **Tier 2 (single skill)**: Fetch ONLY the skill you need via `GET https://hanzoskills.com/skills/<id>/SKILL.md` (or `/skills/<id>.json` or `/<id>.md`).

## Hanzo Philosophy & Ecosystem

- [Onboarding Manifest](https://hanzoskills.com/skill.md): what runs locally, commands to start each part, and hosted cloud boundaries.
- [Install Hanzo](https://hanzo.sh): `curl -fsSL https://hanzo.sh | sh` installs the CLI, MCP server, and dev agent.
- [HIP Specifications](https://hips.hanzo.ai/llms.txt): Hanzo Improvement Proposals progressive index.
- [MCP Progressive Index](https://hanzoskills.com/mcp/index.json): 13 unified HIP-0300 tools (<1.5k tokens).
- [Open Source Repositories](https://hanzoskills.com/oss/index.json): build, fork, and mod any Hanzo repo.
- [API Reference](https://docs.hanzo.ai/llms.txt): api.hanzo.ai operations.
- [Company](https://hanzo.ai/llms.txt): what Hanzo builds and runs.

## Start Here

- [skill](https://hanzoskills.com/skills/skill/SKILL.md): Manifest for an AI agent working with Hanzo — what runs on your own machine and the command that starts it, what needs an account on the hosted cloud at api.hanzo.ai, and how to work either way safely. Onboarding (a c...
- [hanzo](https://hanzoskills.com/skills/hanzo/SKILL.md): Sign up free with a wallet. Get an API key free. A small free allowance to try it. Top up in USDC or USDT over the API to raise your limits and pay as you go. No human required. Onboard an agent onto Hanzo, the AI ope...
- [hanzo-base](https://hanzoskills.com/skills/hanzo-base/SKILL.md): Hanzo Base is an open source Go backend that provides a complete application backend in a single binary.
- [hanzo-cloud](https://hanzoskills.com/skills/hanzo-cloud/SKILL.md): hanzoai/cloud is ONE Go binary that embeds every Hanzo-native subsystem — IAM, KMS, o11y, tasks, notify, pubsub, kafka, console, ai (the former LLM control plane), and the rest — behind a single plugin registry.
- [hanzo-mcp](https://hanzoskills.com/skills/hanzo-mcp/SKILL.md): Hanzo MCP implements the Model Context Protocol -- an open standard for exposing tools, resources, and prompts to AI agents.
- [app-port](https://hanzoskills.com/skills/app-port/SKILL.md): Port an existing application onto the Hanzo stack — Hanzo Base and Hanzo Cloud OSS for the backend, ZAP for transport, @hanzo/ui and @hanzo/gui for the interface — and move its Python or JavaScript runtime into Go, Ru...

## Categories (Tier 1 Indexes)

- [Hanzo Platform & Cloud](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/hanzo.md) (165 skills · [JSON](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/hanzo.json)): Core Hanzo stack, native Go/Rust/C++ services, Base, Cloud, CLI, MCP, and migration guides. Samples: skill, hanzo, hanzo-base, hanzo-cloud.
- [AI, ML & Agent Engineering](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/ai-agents.md) (120 skills · [JSON](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/ai-agents.json)): LLM APIs, agent workflows, MCP servers, skill authoring, inference, audio, vision, and research. Samples: accessibility, agent-cli-patterns, agent-design, ai-image-prompting.
- [Systems & Core Engineering](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/engineering.md) (551 skills · [JSON](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/engineering.json)): Languages, distributed systems, debugging, testing, code review, protocols, and build tools. Samples: ab-test-analysis, ab-test-setup, ab-testing, academy-guide.
- [Cloud, Containers & DevOps](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/cloud-infra.md) (71 skills · [JSON](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/cloud-infra.json)): Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, observability, edge deploys, and site architecture. Samples: api-live, blueprint-spec, cicd-cd-deployment-patterns, cicd-ci-optimization.
- [Data, Databases & Analytics](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/data-databases.md) (21 skills · [JSON](https://hanzoskills.com/categories/data-databases.json)): SQL, vector search, data engineering, streaming pipelines, and product analytics.
